notes.title: PULSE RED
notes.content:
🔥 Pulse Red is LIVE. 🔥
 This one’s not for the faint of heart.


You’re stepping into an experimental challenge level - raw, intense, and built to push limits. But here’s the twist: we’re testing the boundaries with you. Your runs will help us tune just how far the chaos can go before release.

Your mission: rack up the highest score you can. Your reward: eternal bragging rights. The top 5 names will be carved into Tempo Punk itself when the full game drops.

No sign-ups. No barriers. Just jump back into the demo and face the fire.

The beat is red. The iron is hot. Strike now.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851795/243094df597b3d0a55b7b5198a75fce9f17e8e83.gif"]

notes.title: Demo is live!
notes.content:
You wanted answers after that cliffhanger?

Here they are — and they come crashing in with full force.


The Tempo Punk Demo is OUT NOW!

Step into our beat-driven shooter madness and rip through the most insane vertical slice we’ve built to date.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851795/5294f2b739cda9f005dce01b9dfbdc3ead00c5aa.gif"]

And we’re just getting started - Boomstock 2025 kicks off TODAY.

Catch the live showcase at 10am PST / 7pm CEST and witness the brand-NEW Tempo Punk trailer in all its violent, rhythmic glory. Don’t miss it.



Here is the link to the showcase: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/rEZH2KYG-Lw?si=0V43KwL8SuLS5-9g"][/dynamiclink]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851795/0e8701ddddc59a5164ddc04322afbb9dc22c9b8d.png"]


But hold up -  we’re not done.

Tomorrow marks the start of something new: Pulse Red.

A community event like no other - details dropping soon.



Stay sharp. The beat doesn’t stop here.

notes.title: Devlog - Oppressor Enemies
notes.content:
Throughout the last month we've revealed a bunch of new enemies you'll encounter, they all come from the "Oppressor" faction and haven't been seen at all in our pre-alpha demo. I wanted to share these new enemies with you (aka the few people that'll randomly come across out steam announcements)!

Anyway let me introduce you to the upcoming enemy line-up. Keep in mind these are in very early development and could just as easily end up getting cut, renamed or reworked entirely, y'know typical development nonsense.

Oppressor Harasser
This bipedal mech features rocket pods for arms, it'll jump around the arena and fire off a barrage of rockets in your direction, really it's more of a carpet bombing now that I think about it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851795/f150537cdc9e26c2912e5881ff0784f5ff534f39.gif

Below you'll see some prototype-level demonstrations of how it'll roughly function in-game, of course it's lacking a ton of animations and seems practically harmless at the moment, we'll worry about its balancing as we implement it into the actual game, just imagine its shooting rockets out of its pods for me please.

[previewyoutube=FZ4G-5UcdPY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube=jM6rw7aRj3s;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Oppressor Sentinel
A sharp-legged cyborg which will feature two variants. Offensive and defensive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851795/3d2877e6fd5aba5e844d0736667b9313126efab5.gif

An offensive variant will run around the arena and fire off a rocket from its... uhh...

[previewyoutube=d4COTfRzGAU;full][/previewyoutube]

A defensive variant will carry two ballistic shields, it'll deploy a shield barrier which pulses with the level's music. While it has the shield barrier deployed it'll toss pods at the player, these pods will open up to release two slicer drones that aren't super tough, but we feel like it'll definitely add more to the encounter.

[previewyoutube=YPurwA-DA6s;full][/previewyoutube]


Slicer Drones & Pod
And here's a better look at those drones, features a very neat pod opening animation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851795/c5d11389412da93a28331bdcb0afdc26ee674aa6.gif

This wraps up what we've been cooking up since the pre-alpha demo, of course there's more to show but we gotta keep some surprises to ourselves, right?
As always join our Discord server or follow us on Twitter/X if you wanna see these dev logs the moment they're posted.

notes.title: V1RAL to Tempo Punk - DEVLOG
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WOcIw7E4BLE;full][/previewyoutube]

Text Summary
this'll be a paraphrased summary of the video
We generally call this thing we're making "Project Black". It initially started as a passion project inspired by the surge of retro shooters from around the year 2019.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851795/de54c328502263eccbc799c4ced27e9b67e04e2b.jpg

While V1RAL had neat retro visuals and interesting ideas, it was self-admittedly very rough around the edges, the enemies felt practically useless, not to mention the complaints we got about the game's pixelization being much too intense.
Then there was virtually no progress made on V1RAL in the year 2022, when it came time to return to this project it felt like we were missing the retro shooter train, but felt inspired by the way V1RAL's music corresponds to what was happening in-game, hence why we greatly shifted focus.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41851795/487d56b8bd1d61d786d8fe1cd8f31eed951db638.png

This is where the project evolved to become Tempo Punk, the art style has completely changed but at its core this is still V1RAL. We're using a lot of what we learned from our past development and made tons of improvements with a rhythm-based twist.
As different as the game looks we believe that this is still V1RAL at its core, we've kept what worked about our previous iteration and improved upon it. Overall we're feeling confident with the switch to the rhythm genre and hope you'll stick around as we continue development!
